status.en: 19 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 138% more than the week before, most of them in Kivu, Kinshasa and Kivu.
status.nb: 19 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 138 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Kivu, Kinshasa og Kivu.

summary.en: M23 rebels are advancing in eastern DRC, seizing towns and planning a housing project in Goma, while ADF gunmen continue killing civilians in Ituri. A WHO Ebola response team was trapped for over 24 hours near a hospital in Ituri and forced to shelter in a maternity ward, prompting WHO to call for evacuation. South African mercenaries have been captured in eastern DRC. Kenya and the DRC presidents have agreed to restore diplomatic ties after a meeting in Brazzaville. 1,158 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: M23‑opprørerne rykker frem i østlige DRC, tar byer og planlegger et boligprosjekt i Goma, mens ADF-våpnere fortsetter å drepe sivile i Ituri. Et WHO-Ebolateam ble fanget i over 24 timer nær et sykehus i Ituri og måtte søke tilflukt på en fødeavdeling, noe som får WHO til å kreve evakuering. Sør-afrikanske leiesoldater er blitt tatt til fange i østlige DRC. Kenya‑ og DRC-presidentene har blitt enige om å gjenopprette diplomatiske forbindelser etter et møte i Brazzaville. 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
